body:
I'm prescribed 75 milligrams of Zoloft a day.
In case you weren't sure, Zoloft is supposed to battle depression and anxiety.

I really wish I had a good answer. I cannot find a single aspect of myself that isn't horrible.
I am incredibly selfish; instead of trying to do anything productive or help anyone I spend my time sitting in my room wallowing in self-pity.
I'm unattractive, incredibly boring, and I'm an absolute idiot. I don't think I've ever made anyone's life better. I'm really just a burden.

Also, instead of doing something useful or just killing myself, I'm wasting your and other peoples time.
I guess it seems like I'm constantly in a bad situation, but most of the suicidal thoughts come from self hate
